function asserted<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): number {
  const item: number = items[index]!;
  return item;
}

function compared<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): number {
  const item = items[index];
  if (item !== undefined) {
    const length: number = item;
    return length;
  }
  return 0;
}

function unnarrowed<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): string {
  const item = items[index];
  const text: string = item;
  return text;
}

function filled<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): number {
  const item: number = (items[index] ??= "filled");
  return item;
}

function parameterAsserted<T extends string | undefined>(value: T): number {
  const length: number = value!;
  return length;
}

function parameterUnnarrowed<T extends string | undefined>(value: T): string {
  if (value === undefined) {
    const text: string = value;
    return text;
  }
  return value;
}
